plainDesc: Send a signal, get an answer and a receipt. Re-check the receipt yourself and you get the same result.
desc: This API — deterministic tasks over 15 real connectome wirings (maps of living nervous systems captured by electron microscopy). Every answer comes with a receipt you can replay yourself and get the identical result.

plain: Every result leaves a permanent fingerprint
plainDesc: Every reading and every answer is sealed with a code and kept forever. Change one letter and the seal breaks.
desc: As receipts: every reading and task is content-addressed and persisted — tamper-evident commitments, not bulk storage. What runs today is the evidence ledger; organism-bound store is consent-gated below.

plainDesc: A small box hears birds, bugs and plant clicks from a distance. Nothing attaches, nothing enters soil.
desc: Passive multimodal sensing — audio, ultrasonic, environmental, camera, hydrophone front-end on one ~$35–45 node. Nothing attaches, nothing enters soil. Firmware + actors e2e-tested; field-validation gate E0 not yet run.

plainDesc: Lots of boxes listen at once, and the cloud counts it only when they agree.
desc: The second evidence lane — multi-node fleet readings folding into quorum. Same gate: admitted only when the lane's evidence SAID lands.

plainDesc: Boxes pass sealed notes to each other, like a note down a row of desks. Only sealed notes can be passed.
desc: Node→node mesh hops — Reticulum store-and-forward carrying only content-addressed bundles: an intent names the packet SAID it moves or it refuses. The network hop, not the biological one.

plain: Talking back — only with two keys
plainDesc: Sending a small sound back to nature. It needs two yeses: the guardian's and the box owner's.
desc: The write lane exists and is fully implemented — it rides only on joint guardian + operator consent, duty-cycled minimum power, every burst logged and receipted.

plainDesc: Sending a sound to many at once. Same rule: two yeses, or nothing happens.
desc: Broadcast lane — same joint-consent gate: guardian + operator, consent credential SAID, never a default.

plainDesc: Saving data with a living thing, like a plant. Locked until both the guardian and the box owner say yes.
desc: Organism-bound storage — writing into living systems. Consent-gated by policy; distinct from the evidence ledger running above.

plain: Asking a plant to carry a message
plainDesc: Sending signals through living things. Blocked until there is proof it works without harm.
desc: Relay through living wiring — refused outright: consent is not evidence. E5 is the graduation path: its preserved-wiring harness already passes (15/15 relays replay bit-for-bit across two verifiers), the living half stays refused until evidence lands.

plain: Asking a forest to do math
plainDesc: Computing done by living things. Blocked until there is proof it is real.
desc: Living-systems compute — refused until an evidence SAID lands. What the field has published as possible is cited in the evidence table — we claim the receipts, not the miracle.

plainDesc: Living things changed by people in a lab. Not part of this project — wild and natural systems only.
desc: Engineered-biology lanes — refused outright. Natural and wild systems only; no engineered substrate carries a lane here.
